steps.en: Build the kernel binary with the Go toolchain
steps.zh: 用 Go 工具链构建内核二进制

steps.en: Copy the shipped kernelspec into Jupyter's kernel dir
steps.zh: 把自带的 kernelspec 复制进 Jupyter 内核目录

steps.en: Rewrite kernel.json to point at the installed binary
steps.zh: 改写 kernel.json 指向装好的二进制

steps.en: Start Jupyter and pick Go from the New menu
steps.zh: 启动 Jupyter，在 New 菜单里选 Go

steps.en: Evaluates each cell through its embedded gomacro interpreter, keeping state across cells
steps.zh: 经内嵌的 gomacro 解释器逐 cell 求值，cell 间状态保持

value.en: Interactive, shareable Go notebooks — run a cell, tweak, re-run — without a compile-link cycle per snippet
value.zh: 可交互、可分享的 Go 笔记本——跑一个 cell、改、再跑——不必每个片段都编译链接

sources: github.com/gopherdata/gophernotes README (master, retrieved 2026-09-28): 'go install github.com/gopherdata/gophernotes@v0.7.5'; 'cp kernel/* ~/.local/share/jupyter/kernels/gophernotes'; 'sed "s|gophernotes|$(go env GOPATH)/bin/gophernotes|" < kernel.json.in > kernel.json'; 'jupyter notebook'; 'Select Go from the New drop down menu' (README snippets still pin v0.7.5; latest tag v0.7.6)
gophernotes GitHub releases API (2026-09-28): v0.7.6 published 2026-09-23, 'Update to latest gomacro: adds minimal support for go/types.Alias'
